method: Rendered the listed pages of the final PDF individually and visually inspected the formulas, proofs, page breaks and updated proof program. Inspected the current overview, technical interface graph and complete source namespace diagram as rendered PNG previews.
result: No clipped text, overlapping mathematics, broken formulas or unreadable mathematical glyphs found on inspected pages. The overview and technical graph show both status words and status colours; the source diagram clearly identifies namespace containment rather than proof dependencies.
limits: Only the listed pages and diagrams were visually inspected. This is layout verification, not mathematical proof certification.
